<!--
Ametrite keeps a deliberately small surface: one binary, one SQLite file, a
handful of dependencies, no cloud. Larger ideas are still welcome; be honest
about scope so the discussion stays grounded.
-->

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who experiences it (a human, an agent,
an orchestrator running many agents)? Concrete examples land better than
abstract framings.

## Proposed solution

What would you like Ametrite to do? If you have a sketch of the CLI, MCP
tool, or `--json` output, include it.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.
